headline: CENTERRA + TECK BACK MAIDEN DRILL AT UNTESTED TOODOGGONE PORPHYRY — METAL ENERGY LAUNCHES 6,000M NIV COPPER-GOLD PROGRAM (TSXV:MERG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV:MERG)
snippet: Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV:MERG) commenced its inaugural drill program July 6, 2026 at the NIV copper-gold project in BC's Toodoggone district — 6,000+ metres across 12 holes testing a 5-kilometre porphyry trend with coincident copper-gold-molybdenum soil geochemistry, chargeability anomalies, and porphyry-style surface veining, approximately 32 km south of Centerra Gold's Kemess mine complex. The institutional signal is exceptional: Centerra Gold and Teck Resources have each taken 9.9% strategic positions in Metal Energy, with Metal Energy holding approximately $9 million in cash ahead of the program. CEO Charlie Greig is a geologist whose most notable prior work was assembling the key geological elements of what became the GT Gold Saddle discovery — ultimately acquired for approximately $450 million in 2021. NIV is one of the most compelling untested copper-gold porphyry targets currently being drilled in BC, backed by two of Canada's largest copper-gold producers. For retail junior mining investors, the combination of major-company strategic buy-ins, a fully funded inaugural drill, and a CEO with a specific prior discovery track record in the same geological setting represents the institutional endorsement trifecta rarely seen at a TSXV exploration-stage company.

headline: 40 YEARS, 20,000 METRES: ONTARIO'S LARGEST PRIMARY COPPER FINALLY GETS ITS FIRST LARGE-SCALE DRILL PERMIT — XXIX METAL THIERRY (TSXV:XXIX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / XXIX Metal Corp. (TSXV:XXIX)
snippet: XXIX Metal Corp. (TSXV:XXIX) announced July 6, 2026 receipt of its exploration permit from the Province of Ontario for the 100%-owned Thierry Copper Project near Pickle Lake, Ontario — clearing the path for the first systematic, large-scale drill program on the property in over 40 years. The permit unlocks a two-phase 20,000-metre program at the K1 deposit, targeting grade, scale, and continuity to underpin an updated mineral resource estimate. XXIX now interprets K1 as a single, near-surface, disseminated bulk-tonnage copper-PGE system suited to open-pit development, measuring approximately 1.4 km of strike by 250 m wide to 400 m depth — with grade believed to increase with depth, where the deposit remains open. The company holds over $19 million in cash and approximately $24 million in working capital following its $17.2 million financing, and is fully funded through 2026 to advance both Thierry and its Opemiska copper project in Quebec. Thierry is identified in multiple market analyses as Ontario's largest primary copper resource — making the 40-year absence of systematic large-scale drilling a historical anomaly now being corrected at COMEX copper near $6.13/lb, the highest sustained copper price in history.

headline: BHP'S TIMOK JV PARTNER MUNDORO COMPLETES SKORUSA EAST 1,288M — OUTER PORPHYRY MARGINS CONFIRMED IN SERBIA, ASSAYS DUE JULY (TSXV:MUN)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Mundoro Capital Inc. (TSXV:MUN)
snippet: Mundoro Capital Inc. (TSXV:MUN) announced July 6, 2026 completion of a 1,288-metre diamond drill program at the Skorusa East target within the Central Timok Project in Serbia's Timok Magmatic Complex — one of the world's most prolific copper-gold porphyry districts, host to Zijin Mining's Cukaru Peki deposit. Holes 26-SKO-08 (1,288m total depth) and 26-SKO-09 (788m total depth) intersected the outer alteration envelope of the interpreted Skorusa East porphyry system, with 26-SKO-09 cutting intense advanced argillic alteration with vuggy silica textures from surface to 430m — a hallmark of high-level porphyry systems in the Timok district. Both holes are interpreted as intersecting the outer margins with the potassic core yet untested, setting up follow-up drilling to test the higher-grade centre of the system. Assay results are expected before end of July 2026. BHP, which operates in the South Timok complex adjacent to Mundoro's Central Timok position, contributes institutional geological credibility to the district. For retail investors following copper-gold exploration in Europe's premier porphyry belt, Skorusa East's alteration profile confirmation — before any high-grade intercepts — is the geological milestone that typically precedes a significant step-out drill campaign into the interpreted core.

headline: PERU CLEARS 36,010M DRILL PROGRAM AT COLQUEMAYO — KING COPPER RECEIVES DIA PERMIT FOR HIGH-GRADE CU-AG-AU SYSTEM (TSXV:KCP)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / King Copper Discovery Corp. (TSXV:KCP)
snippet: King Copper Discovery Corp. (TSXV:KCP, OTCQB:TBXXF) announced July 6, 2026 receipt of Declaración de Impacto Ambiental (DIA) approval for the Colquemayo Project in southern Peru — the environmental certification required to proceed to exploration drilling. The permit authorizes up to 36,010 metres of diamond drilling from 40 drill platforms comprising up to 59 drill holes, and the Company is fully funded for the authorized program. Colquemayo is a large high-sulphidation epithermal system with a district-scale lithocap and Cu-Ag-Au mineralisation across multiple zones, situated in Peru's highly productive southern Andes copper belt that hosts several world-class copper mines including Tintaya and Las Bambas. The DIA is a meaningful regulatory milestone in Peru's permitting environment — required before any drilling can commence. King Copper's 36,010-metre program is one of the larger single-project copper exploration drill authorizations seen in Peru in 2026, with the 40-platform, 59-hole design suggesting a systematic district-scale program rather than a single-target test.

headline: HANNAN DRILLS MAIDEN PROGRAM NEAR BOLIDEN — OPTIONS 3 SWEDISH GOLD PROJECTS, 93 G/T HISTORIC SURFACE SAMPLES AT STAVATRÄSK (TSXV:HAN)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV:HAN)
snippet: Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV:HAN) announced July 6, 2026 completion of its 7-hole, 1,040-metre maiden diamond drill program at the Stavaträsk high-grade gold project in the Skellefteå district of northern Sweden, with assay results expected within six weeks and a second 1,000-metre phase planned following review. Simultaneously, the TSX Venture Exchange accepted for filing Hannan's Option Agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Stavaträsk, Skellefteå North, and Ådelfors gold projects in Sweden — three distinct targets in the same district. Stavaträsk occupies a strategic position on the Vidsel-Röjnoret Shear System (VRSS), the same regional structure that hosts the Boliden deposit (4.24 Moz grading 15.9 g/t Au in historic production) — the world-class high-grade gold mine that defines the Skellefteå district globally. Prior surface sampling at Stavaträsk returned grades up to 93 g/t Au and 24 g/t Ag in outcrop, with a separate boulder field returning up to 11.2 g/t Au, 154 g/t Ag, and 2.43% Cu, 650 metres away. Sweden is a Tier-1 mining jurisdiction with streamlined permitting for exploration and a strong geological survey tradition. The Boliden geological analogy, combined with high-grade surface samples on the same shear system, makes Stavaträsk one of the most geologically motivated early-stage gold targets in Scandinavia.

headline: BRUNSWICK DRILLS MIRAGE LITHIUM (52.2MT @ 1.08% LI2O) AND EXTENDS ANATACAU — 6,000M SUMMER PROGRAM, JAMES BAY QUEBEC (TSXV:BRW)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Brunswick Exploration Inc. (TSXV:BRW)
snippet: Brunswick Exploration Inc. (TSXV:BRW, OTCQB:BRWXF) launched its 2026 summer drill program on July 6, targeting both flagship Quebec lithium projects in the Eeyou Istchee-James Bay region with a combined 6,000 metres — approximately 2,000 metres at Anatacau Main and 4,000 metres at Mirage, using a helicopter-borne drill rig over approximately two months. Mirage hosts an inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 52.2 million tonnes grading 1.08% Li2O, making it one of Canada's most significant advanced lithium exploration assets. The Anatacau Main program targets extension of the spodumene pegmatite dyke field — which extends over 600 metres long and 450 metres wide and remains open in all directions — building on prior high-grade results including 90.5 metres at 1.31% Li2O and 17.7 metres at 1.10% Li2O within 123 metres at 0.72% Li2O. For retail lithium investors navigating a market where CATL's Jianxiawo restart has added supply pressure, Brunswick presents the bull case: hard-rock spodumene in Canada's safest lithium jurisdiction, with an existing resource at Mirage that de-risks the capital story while Anatacau's open-ended extension drilling offers a genuinely asymmetric exploration upside.

headline: SILVER-GOLD-ANTIMONY DRILL LAUNCHES AT TAYLOR, NEVADA — A2GOLD TARGETS CRD AND PORPHYRY ON 117 KM² LAND PACKAGE (TSXV:AUAU)
snippet: A2Gold Corp. (TSXV:AUAU) commenced drilling July 6, 2026 at the Taylor Silver-Gold Project in White Pine County, Nevada — a 117 km² district-scale land package acquired June 15, 2026, hosting a large, highly prospective silver-gold system with meaningful antimony, carbonate replacement deposit (CRD), skarn, and porphyry exploration potential. The initial program consists of 16–18 reverse circulation holes for 5,000 metres targeting: expansion of the historical silver resource, gold potential testing, and evaluation of district-scale antimony mineralisation associated with gold across the project. Antimony's strategic relevance has increased sharply following China's September 2024 export restrictions on refined antimony — a material used in military munitions, flame retardants, and advanced battery technology — making Nevada-based antimony exposure with coincident silver-gold an increasingly differentiated portfolio attribute. A2Gold acquired Taylor from White Pine Precious Metals Inc. in an all-share plus deferred-cash arrangement with a 2% NSR retained by the vendor. At silver holding above $62/oz and gold above $4,100/oz, Nevada's permitting framework and A2Gold's district-scale land position make Taylor a freshly catalysed story at the start of its inaugural drill campaign.

headline: CADILLAC BREAK SONIC DRILL COMPLETE ON KERR-ADDISON 40MT TAILINGS — STARDUST TARGETS NI 43-101 RESOURCE FOR FALL 2026 (CSE:ZIGY)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Stardust Metal Corp. (CSE:ZIGY)
snippet: Stardust Metal Corp. (CSE:ZIGY) provided a July 6, 2026 exploration update confirming completion of the sonic drilling program on the historic Kerr-Addison tailings deposit at the McGarry Project on Ontario's Cadillac Break, with all samples submitted to an accredited assay laboratory. The program totalled approximately 2,100 metres on combined 100-metre and 50-metre centres across the tailings body — one of the largest historic tailings accumulations in the Kirkland Lake camp at approximately 40 million tonnes, adjacent to the Kerr-Addison gold mine (one of the most prolific historic producers in Ontario). Metallurgical testing is anticipated for completion during summer 2026, with the full data package — sonic drill assays, met results, density and volumetric data — expected to support an NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate targeted for fall 2026. Stardust also updated its primary hard-rock exploration program along the Cadillac Break. The Cadillac Break is one of the world's most productive gold-hosting structural corridors, and historic gold tailings reprocessing has attracted renewed investor interest at $4,100+ gold — where heap-leach economics on lower-grade material can be economic at grades that weren't viable at $1,500/oz.

headline: SUMMIT SWALLOWS STAR ROYALTIES — 48-ASSET PORTFOLIO WITH COPPERSTONE GOLD STREAM AFTER MERGER CLOSES JULY 3 (TSXV:SUM)
snippet: Summit Royalties Ltd. (TSXV:SUM) completed its acquisition of Star Royalties Ltd. on July 3, 2026, with Summit issuing 28,944,162 common shares at 0.36 Summit shares per Star share. The closing materially expands Summit's royalty and streaming portfolio with the addition of Star's interests — including a 4% gold stream on Mining Americas Inc.'s Copperstone project in Arizona — bringing Summit's combined portfolio to 48 royalties and streams, anchored by four producing assets, two development-stage assets expected to enter construction in 2026 and begin production in 2027, and 42 additional royalty interests providing long-term optionality. Star Royalties shares are expected to be delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange around July 7, 2026, with Star ceasing reporting issuer status. For retail investors, the Summit/Star combination creates a more liquid, diversified royalty vehicle in the TSXV royalty space — the combined 48-asset portfolio across gold, silver, copper, and development-stage properties compares with portfolios held by well-capitalized royalty intermediaries, with the Arizona Copperstone gold stream providing near-term production cash flow exposure at $4,100+ gold.
